The smallest possible sum is \(4+6+8=18\), so no integer below \(18\) can work.

For every \(n\ge 18\):

- If \(n\) is even, then
  \[
  n=4+6+(n-10),
  \]
  where \(n-10\) is an even composite number \(\ge 8\), distinct from \(4,6\).

- If \(n\) is odd, then
  \[
  n=4+9+(n-13),
  \]
  where \(n-13\) is an even composite number \(\ge 6\), distinct from \(4,9\).

Thus every integer \(n\ge 18\) is representable, and the largest nonrepresentable integer is \(17\).

\[
\boxed{17}
\]
